requirements.label: Days worked in the last 12 months

nextStep.Eligible: Log in to e-Shram and check that your platform has reported your work days; if not, raise a grievance on the e-Shram portal.
nextStep.Not eligible: Keep working and keep your platform app records. Re-check once you cross 90 days in the last 12 months. Register on e-Shram now if you have not.
nextStep.Not applicable: This rulebook does not cover this benefit.

requirements.label: On a notified platform (Zomato, Swiggy, Zepto, Urban Company)

nextStep.Eligible: Register with the Karnataka Platform-based Gig Workers Welfare Board and keep your platform ID handy; the fee is paid by the platform, not by you.
nextStep.Not eligible: You are in Karnataka but not on a platform named in the order. Check the board's website for additions.
nextStep.Not applicable: The Karnataka fund covers workers engaged in Karnataka only.
